messages:
Rae: Heads-up  planning a tight social push for the launch: single X post + 4-tweet thread, LinkedIn longform next day, and a 15-20s demo clip. Need 2 headline variants, 2 hero images, and HubSpot routing for webinar regs. Assets by Mon noon pls.
Ben: I can create hero images. Need final stat copy  which should be on-image? throughput or cost?
Kelsey: Put cost on hero ("~40% lower inference cost") and mention 2x throughput in the thread. That hits finance+eng.
Omar: I'll edit the clip to 18s and add an end-frame CTA. Also compress for X (<12MB).
Rae: Copy variants: A = metric-first; B = customer-story. Kelsey, can you draft both and keep the first line <280 chars for X preview?
Kelsey: Drafts uploaded: https://docs.redwood/launch_copy_A and _B. They include UTM placeholders: utm_campaign=launch_jun, utm_content=A|B.
Rae: Routing: all webinar regs -> HubSpot contact with property "social_series" and value 'launch_jun'. Attendees -> mark as 'hot' and notify #sales-inbound. HubSpot-ops please wire Segment -> HubSpot mapping for `social_variant`.
hubspot-bot: Test workflow created and webhook to #sales-inbound confirmed (workflow id: wf_3302). Remember to include `social_variant` field in registration payload.
Ben: Uploaded heroA.png & heroB.png and clip_v1.mp4: https://files.redwood/launch/heroA.png. Filenames include variant suffix.
Omar: Trimmed clip, reduced music, added 1.5s CTA hold. Compressed file uploaded.
Rae: Schedule proposal: X announcement Tue 9:30am PT, follow-up thread 2 hours later with demo clip, LinkedIn longform Wed 10am PT. Buffer queue ok?
Ben: Queueing drafts in Buffer, tagging Rae for final approval.
Kelsey: I'll add 3 quick reply templates for engagement (thanks, question, demo-invite) and post them in the doc.
Rae: Great work. Final ask: include UTM-ified shortlink go.red/launchjun in all CTAs and ensure analytics tracks variant. Approving after a quick review tonight. :rocket:
